summary: The rsyslog queue starts writing to disk at 75% of the max message count and drops NOTICE, INFO and DEBUG at 90%. Maximum disk persistence (default 1 GB, `queue.maxdiskspace`) is stored in `LOG_AGGREGATOR_MAX_DISK_USAGE_PATH` (default `/var/lib/awx`, `queue.spoolDirectory`); there are also API 4XX log format and Log System Tracking Facts Individually options.
questions: What happens when the controller rsyslog queue fills up?
Where does AAP buffer logs when the aggregator is down?
Why are INFO logs being dropped by controller?
